scripts.build: DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://d:d@localhost:5432/d} npx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://d:d@localhost:5432/d} npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://d:d@localhost:5432/d} node prisma/seed.js && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://d:d@localhost:5432/d} node seed_import.js imo && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://d:d@localhost:5432/d} node seed_import.js usamo && next build
scripts.start: sh -c "echo DB_INIT_START; npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1; echo SEED_START; node prisma/seed.js 2>&1; echo SERVER_START; next start -p $PORT"
scripts.setup: DATABASE_URL=file:/data/app.db npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL=file:/data/app.db node prisma/seed.js
